title: Sprint D review fixes: gitlab gap closings cite article facts, gap notes sit on sub-bullets, four article defects
goal: every gitlab _gaps.md entry whose closing note dated 2026-10-2x rests on a code read, a local run or a page read cites a tagged gitlab article fact by path:line (CODE with a pinned source row and a path#Lx-Ly pointer, DER for a run, DOC for a page) or is reworded as a Tried note; every _gaps.md note sits on its own indented sub-bullet, none on its entry's line; arch/k8s-gmsa-windows.md no longer says no kubernetes.io page states a Windows Server floor, the mecm/log-files.md claim that BitLocker management is the only ConfigMgr component with event channels carries a DER tag, gpo/gpo-export.md states the managed-domain and AGPM backup layouts as DOC facts with the caveat that they are not Backup-GPO output, and the _gaps.md note that names the endpoint DLP getting started page cites a source row for each page it names

run:
import re, sys
P = re.compile(r'^- .*\) - (?:Tried|Resolved|Partly resolved|Narrowed|Closed|Superseded) 20\d\d-')
bad = [n for n, t in enumerate(open('kb/public/_gaps.md', encoding='utf-8'), 1) if P.match(t)]
print(len(bad), '_gaps.md entry lines that carry a note on the entry line instead of a sub-bullet', bad[:30])
sys.exit(1 if bad else 0)
